usedFor: Zoho Recruit holds recruiting records, and “Create Record” and “Update Record Status” add them and move them on.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal” in Kylas CRM, then “Create Record” in Zoho Recruit
bestTemplate.why: A new deal becomes a record in the module you choose.

watchOut: “Create Record” works in a selected module, so check you picked the right one.
